column3: Close to the Hebrew; “hip and thigh” renders the idiom “leg upon thigh.”
Close to the Hebrew; “came mightily upon” renders “rushed upon,” and NKJV capitalizes “Spirit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Heaps upon heaps” plays on the Hebrew word for “donkey” (hamor).
Close to the Hebrew; “Ramath Lehi” means “jawbone height.”
Close to the Hebrew; “En Hakkore” means “spring of the one who called.”
